title: Writing: Timed Tasks
focus: Distribuir tempo entre estrutura, e-mail e discussão
verifiableTask: Concluir três tarefas de escrita com cronômetro

content.text: Ao final da aula você consegue:
distribuir seu tempo e não deixar nenhuma tarefa incompleta.
concluir três tarefas de escrita com cronômetro.
Do you usually finish writing tasks on time? Where do you lose time?
Do you plan before writing? Do you revise after?
I usually spend too much time
, so I don't have time to
→ writing the first sentence / finish → thinking of perfect words / check grammar → counting words / write the conclusion
due to the fact that → because…
Divisão de tempo (sugestão para treino; confirme os tempos oficiais no site da ETS)
~30–40 s por item — leia a fala, ache o verbo, monte, confira.
1 min planejar (checklist dos pontos) · 5 min escrever · 1 min revisar.
1–2 min ler e planejar · 7 min escrever · 1–2 min revisar.
I'll outline for one minute, write for seven, and proofread for two.

questions.questionText: To check a text for small mistakes is to ______ it.

options.text: a short plan of the main points

explanations.general: Correct answer: a short plan of the main points
Correct answer: Points from the prompt covered
My first draft had many mistakes.

questions.questionText: For the discussion task in this practice, how much time to plan?

content.text: → escreva o plano em palavras-chave, não frases.
Ficar preso em um item de Build a Sentence
Write to your landlord: the heater is broken. Explain the problem, say what you've done, ask for a repair date.
heater broken since Mon · tried reset + checked power · cold, exam week · repair before Fri? · thanks
Pos: yes, ban phones in class · conn: agree w/ Lia (distraction) + add · R1: memory — handwriting notes · Ex: my exp. · Counter: emergencies → phones at front desk
O professor lê o enunciado; o aluno fala o plano em palavras-chave.
Email: You can't attend a job interview at the scheduled time. Write to the recruiter: apologize, explain, suggest two new times.
Discussion: Should universities replace textbooks with free online materials?
Email: Your neighbor's dog barks every night. Write a polite message.
Dear Mr. Silva, I am writing because heater is broken since Monday. I tryed to reset it, but it don't work. Could you send someone to repair? Thank you, Bruno

questions.questionText: Which correction is right? “heater is broken since Monday”

options.text: the heater is broken since Monday
the heater has been broken since Monday

explanations.A: Ainda falta o tempo verbal certo.
explanations.B: Correto: artigo + presente perfeito com since.
explanations.general: Correct answer: the heater has been broken since Monday

questions.questionText: I ______ to reset it. (try — passado, grafia correta)
Which is complete? “Could you send someone to repair?”

options.text: Could you send someone to repair it?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Could you send someone to repair it?

questions.questionText: What is the BEST plan format?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Keywords and short phrases

questions.questionText: If you get stuck on a Build a Sentence item, it's better to make your best guess and move on.

content.text: 5. Tarefas cronometradas (15 min — sem pausa entre elas)

you / tried / the writing center / have / ?
know / don't / I / is / where / it
I / up / until / stayed / studying / 2 a.m.
as / I'll / soon / them / as / send / get / I / home

You booked a study room at the library for your group, but when you arrived, another group was using it. Write to the library: describe what happened, explain why it was a problem, and ask what they can do.
Should universities require students to take at least one online course before graduating?
Yes, because many jobs now involve online work and communication.
No. Some students learn much better face to face, and they shouldn't be forced.

questions.questionText: Put in order: was / it / to / moved / Thursday

explanations.general: Correct answer: It was moved to Thursday.

questions.questionText: Put in order: you / tried / the writing center / have / ? → Have you ______ the writing center?

explanations.general: Have you tried the writing center?

questions.questionText: Put in order: know / don't / I / is / where / it

options.text: I don't know where is it.
I don't know where it is.
I know don't where it is.

explanations.general: Correct answer: I don't know where it is.

questions.questionText: Put in order: I / up / until / stayed / studying / 2 a.m. → I stayed ______ studying until 2 a.m.

explanations.general: I stayed up studying until 2 a.m.

questions.questionText: What does the “S” in S-V-A-P-O remind you to check?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Subjects in all sentences

questions.questionText: Revising for 1–2 minutes is a waste of time in the exam.

explanations.general: Falso: a revisão corrige erros simples que custam pontos.
